item.title: Cabinet clears enhanced fiscal incentives for ultra-deepwater offshore drilling projects
item.description: The Union Cabinet has approved a special policy package reducing royalty rates and extending exploration concession periods for ultra-deepwater blocks at depths exceeding 1,500 metres under the Samudra Manthan initiative.

item.title: Vedanta Cairn Oil & Gas plans $1.2 billion offshore capex in Ravva and Cambay fields
item.description: Vedanta's upstream wing Cairn Oil & Gas announced an investment roadmap targeting shallow water drilling and workover operations in the Ravva offshore block.

item.title: Edtech startups explore consolidation to achieve sustainable unit economics
item.description: Education technology platforms are discussing mergers and cost optimization steps to improve operating margins.
